newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Utilicorp NZ ups relevant interest in PNZ.
newsitem.headline: Utilicorp NZ ups relevant interest in PNZ.

text.p: Utilicorp NZ, an 80 percent subsidiary of Utilicorp United, said on Thursday it had increased its relevant interest in Power New Zealand Ltd to 43.79 percent from 42.76 percent previously.
Utilicorp said the number of ordinary shares of which it is the registered holder had increased to 43.49 million from 41.93 million between July 24 and September 3.
In addition to its direct holding, it said last month it had entered oral first right of refusal arrangements with several local authorities who each hold stakes in PNZ.
The authorities were Hauraki District Council, Matamata-Piako District Council, South Waikato District Council and the Thames-Coromandel District Council.
PNZ is at the centre of a takeover battle between unlisted Mercury Energy and Utilicorp.
Mercury, which holds just over 31 percent of PNZ, has challenged the legality of the arrangements.
The High Court is to hear the case on September 9.
